key_insight: TEMPLAR uses an agentic, template-centric framework to automatically induce and continually refine standardized radiology reporting templates from large clinical corpora.
clinical_relevance: It could help hospitals create more consistent radiology reports that better support structured documentation, report reconstruction, and diagnosis-oriented reasoning.
method: Builds a persistent template state plus anatomy and diagnostic knowledge graphs.
Uses an Induction Agent to derive canonical slots from report spans and cluster them by similarity.
Uses an Evolution Agent to assemble and revise hierarchical templates with external evidence and feedback.
evidence_signal: Across four datasets, TEMPLAR outperformed ASTAR and multiple LLM baselines in coverage, information fidelity, and diagnostic fidelity, with strong cross-dataset transfer.
watch_item: Real-world deployment may require careful integration of local reporting standards, clinical evidence sources, and workflow feedback to avoid template drift or misalignment.
paper_title: templar: agentic induction and evolution of standardized radiology reporting templates from large-scale clinical corpora
